title: Representation-aware accepted-state authority for deliberately coarse Richards reductions
purpose: Determine whether R4/R2 can be evaluated as deliberately reduced hydrological models without inheriting a numerically indistinguishable full-order Reference calibration threshold, while preserving hard mass accounting, finite physical state and fail-closed semantics.

motivation.F_ROMV2_rule: Reduced hydrological models are not automatically subject to the same numerical-equivalence envelope as alternative solvers for the full Richards model.
motivation.D2_result: R4 and R2 failed only the frozen strict local-balance Reference-sample authority before hydrological fidelity could be measured.
motivation.independent_numerical_authority: PUB-P2E07 found the fixed 1e-12 cm/day local Reference criterion not numerically distinguishable from the preregistered representation-floor diagnostic in 102/103 diagnosed full-order local-balance failure states.
motivation.anti_tuning: D3 tolerance formulas are derived from pre-existing P2E07 representation-floor logic and the pre-existing hard transaction mass gate. No D2 residual magnitude is used to set a numerical threshold.

reattempt_trigger: head convergence flag count is zero
failed committed state is unchanged bitwise
all prospective representation bounds are finite and positive
reduced_model_numerical_policy.prospective_local_integrated_bound_cm: For each cell i, b_i = 0.5*(spacing(theta_s)+spacing(theta_base_i))*dz_i. This uses only the pre-attempt committed input state and material theta_s.
acceptance_after_reattempt: solver returns converged with one research Reference physical advance
no internal retry and no kernel retry
candidate is finite and physically bounded
bottom exchange and terminal bottom flux are finite
accepted transaction water ledger is complete
absolute accepted transaction mass residual <= 1e-12 cm
candidate commits through the kernel owner
reduced_model_numerical_policy.fail_closed: Any head failure, mixed failure, nonfinite bound, failed representation-aware reattempt, hard mass failure or physical-state failure stops that geometry/history. No further widening is allowed.
reduced_model_numerical_policy.scientific_boundary: This is a research-only numerical distinguishability policy for deliberately reduced models. It is not a Reference solver tolerance change, not production policy and not a claim of numerical equivalence to R16.

hydrological_evaluation.reference_geometry: R16 under the same strict-first representation-aware research policy
frontier_views: balance: node count / nonlinear work versus storage and cumulative-bottom-exchange error
event: node count / nonlinear work versus bottom-flux magnitude, sign and reversal fidelity

decisions.family_rule: R4/R2 are retained only if they complete with integrity. Completion does not imply application acceptance.
decisions.successor_if_positive: Compare surviving R4/R2 with R8 and a clean-sheet quasi-steady/integrated-manifold reduction.
decisions.successor_if_negative: Do not widen numerical policy. Move to quasi-steady/integrated-manifold physical reduction.
